description: The depositor Pujari publishes one BDEW standard household electricity-load profile generated using the Python demandlib library. The December 2023 record lists Load_Profile_H0.csv and scales annual consumption to 4.7 megawatt-hours. It is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. This is a synthetic standard profile, not a measured household trace or an inventory of real consumers. It can provide a small demand input for distribution-network, storage or household-energy simulations when the standard profile’s assumptions are appropriate. The public description does not state the calendar year, time step, timezone or demandlib version, so timestamp and energy-sum checks are needed before use. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this generated file. Its source methodology is BDEW H0 through demandlib; the implementation and output values were not independently reproduced or downloaded.
